name: Hypermorphic Fury
summary: Aberrants, Biophagus and Purestrain Genestealers units get +1 to Charge rolls; if such a unit charged this turn, its melee weapons get +1 Attacks when it fights.

name: Psionic Parasitism
summary: Each Movement phase end, per Tyranids Synapse unit: a Cults unit within 9" takes D3+1 mortal wounds; a Tyranids unit heals as much and gains +1 to Hit for a turn. Cults hit enemies within 6" of Tyranids at +1. Invaders capped 500/1000/1500.

name: Killer Reputation
summary: Friendly Kelermorph, Locus, Reductus Saboteur and Sanctus models gain the Killer keyword. Killer models can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

name: A Perfect Ambush
summary: A Genestealer Cults unit arriving as Reinforcements has Sustained Hits 1 and Ignores Cover on its weapons until the end of your next Fight phase.

name: Rapid Takeover
summary: Cults Mounted/Vehicle models not Battle-shocked get +1 Objective Control. At the end of your Command phase, an objective you control with Atalan Jackals in range stays yours until the enemy's Level of Control there is higher at a phase end.

name: Enemy Within
summary: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, friendly unengaged PURESTRAIN GENESTEALER units can be placed in strategic reserves. This detachment has the PURESTRAIN tag and cannot be taken with another PURESTRAIN detachment.

name: Unquestioning Fanaticism
summary: For each ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS and NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit from your army, while one or more CHARACTER models are leading that unit, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for it. If that CHARACTER model is a MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD, that model has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability while leading that unit.

name: Hordes of the Faithful
summary: In your Command phase, a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit that is within a terrain area heals 3 wounds. This detachment has the HOSTS tag and cannot be taken alongside another HOSTS detachment.
